title: How a 60-Second Habit Keeps a Godly Man From Living Two Different Lives
caption:
Before you walk into the office, the gym, or your parents' house, take ten seconds and name who you're about to be around. It sounds small. It's the difference between drifting into a version of yourself and choosing one.

Here's the habit. A ten-second prayer before you cross a threshold: God, let me be the same man in here that I am on my knees. Run it at the door that tempts the split the most, the locker room, the group chat, the family dinner where everyone expects the old you.

One prayer at one door won't fix a double life by itself. Run it at every door for thirty days and watch how much less there is to hide by day thirty.
